title: Ternary + logical operators
solution:
let marks = 82
let grade = marks >= 90 ? "A" : marks >= 80 ? "B" : marks >= 70 ? "C" : marks >= 50 ? "D" : "F"
console.log(grade) // B
let isLoggedIn = true
let isAdmin = false
let access = isLoggedIn && isAdmin ? "admin" : isLoggedIn ? "user" : "guest"
console.log(access) // user
